title: ShapleyOG: Fast Adaptive Shapley Value Estimation with Odd Gaussian Processes
abstract: arXiv:2611.07173v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Shapley values are a central tool for attribution in machine learning. Since their exact computation requires evaluating the cooperative game to be explained on exponentially many player coalitions, they are typically estimated from a limited number of evaluations. Recently, ShaplEIG has shown that adaptively selecting the coalitions to evaluate substantially improves sample efficiency over classical estimators. This, however, comes at the cost of a sequential procedure that, in every iteration, refits a Gaussian process surrogate of the game and selects the coalition with the largest expected information gain about the Shapley values. The resulting computational overhead limits its applicability to costly games with low evaluation budgets. translated_title: ShapleyOG：基于奇数高斯过程的快速自适应Shapley值估计
translated_abstract: Shapley值是机器学习中进行归因分析的核心工具。由于精确计算Shapley值需要在指数级数量的玩家联盟上评估被解释的合作博弈，因此通常基于有限次数的评估来进行估计。最近的研究（ShaplEIG）表明，自适应地选择要评估的联盟能够显著提高相对于经典估计器的样本效率。然而，这种优势伴随着一个顺序化流程的代价：在每次迭代中，都需要重新拟合博弈的高斯过程代理模型，并选择对Shapley值具有最大信息增益期望的联盟。由此产生的计算开销使其仅适用于评估预算较低的高成本博弈。我们提出了基于奇数高斯过程的快速自适应Shapley值估计方法（ShapleyOG）以克服这一限制。ShapleyOG利用了Shapley值仅依赖于奇数分量这一事实（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: ShapleyOG利用Shapley值仅依赖于奇数分量的特性，提出了一种基于奇数高斯过程的快速自适应估计方法，克服了ShaplEIG等现有自适应方法因每轮迭代重复拟合高斯过程代理模型而带来的计算开销问题。
en_tdlr: ShapleyOG leverages the fact that Shapley values depend only on odd components to enable fast adaptive estimation via Odd Gaussian Processes, overcoming the heavy computational overhead of sequential methods like ShaplEIG that refit Gaussian process surrogates at every iteration.
